name: AI untuk Rakyat Programme
benefits: Free foundational AI micro-credential and 3-month premium AI tools subscription for eligible youth.
notes: Open to all Malaysians; 3-month free AI tool subscription is restricted to citizens aged 18-30 (100k quota). (基础AI课全民免费，18-30岁青年享3个月免费AI工具)

name: Global Learning Pass
benefits: Complimentary 3-month access to 16,000+ Coursera courses and Professional Certificates.
notes: Must activate within 16 days of approval or pass is revoked; Cohort 1 capped at 25,000 slots. (免费享3个月Coursera专业课程与证书)

name: PERKESO EIS Training Programme
benefits: Fully funded professional training tuition plus RM20 daily training allowance.
notes: Requires active PERKESO EIS contributor status and verified retrenchment/unemployment via EIS portal. (全额资助学费并提供每日RM20津贴)

name: HRD Corp e-LATiH
benefits: Free access to over 1,000 online courses covering digital, business, and workplace skills.
notes: Over 1,000 foundational courses are completely free; premium and enterprise courses are also hosted. (基础专区千门课程完全免费)

name: PENJANA KPT-PACE
benefits: Provides up to RM3,000 training and certification vouchers for local tertiary students and graduates.
notes: Administered via participating Malaysian public and private universities; subject to institutional cohort quotas. (高教部最高RM3,000专业认证代金券)

name: Peneraju Profesional Perakaunan (Accounting)
benefits: Full sponsorship for accounting tuition and exams plus monthly living allowance for full-time trainees.
notes: Bumiputera citizens only; convertible financing turns into full scholarship upon passing exams. (全额资助学费考费及津贴，限土著公民)

name: National Structured Internship Programme (MySIP)
benefits: Guaranteed minimum monthly internship allowance for students and double tax deduction for host employers.
notes: Minimum RM600/month for Degree and RM500/month for Diploma interns across approved 10-week internships. (学生获月度保障实习津贴)

name: Global Online Workforce (GLOW) Malaysia
benefits: Free intensive training and mentoring to help Malaysians earn income as global digital freelancers.
notes: Supports unemployed graduates and gig workers in bidding for international freelance digital projects. (免费指导大马公民成为国际数字自由职业者)
